name: 38004 · Atoka, TN
findings: ZIP 38004 (Atoka) has 29 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 38004 (Atoka) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 38004 (Atoka) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 39% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 52% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
